run_check_model_support: run the cli to check if a HuggingFace model tokenizer is supported by transformers-CFG
run_parse_arguments: run the argparse parser to parse CLI subcommands and model name arguments
run_main: run the main entry point to execute the transformers-CFG CLI with a check subcommand
test_check_model_support: test the check_model_support function with a model name and verify it returns a boolean
review_parse_arguments: review the parse_arguments function to understand the CLI subcommand structure and argument definitions
